Name: Yogurt Lid - Health and Energy Preview
Author: ayushua
Description:
[size=5][b]Yogurt Lid / 酸奶盖[/b][/size]
[i]See your recovery before you eat.
吃之前，看见恢复效果。[/i]

[b][size=4]Description / 简介[/size][/b]

Yogurt Lid shows how much health and energy your selected food would restore, directly inside Stardew Valley's vanilla HUD bars. A softly pulsing fill marks the added recovery, with a brown line showing the predicted endpoint.
The preview stays visible and animated in the vanilla “Eat this?” confirmation dialog, even while the game is paused. Check the bars, then decide whether to eat or cancel.

酸奶盖会在快捷栏选中食物时，直接在原版生命条和体力条上，显示这一口预计能补到哪里。半透明填充缓慢呼吸，棕色顶线标出预计恢复终点。
弹出“要吃掉……吗？”确认框后，预览仍持续显示和呼吸。即使游戏时停，也可以看清恢复范围，再决定吃不吃。

[b][size=4]Installation instructions / 安装说明[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod ZIP into your game's Mods folder. You should have Mods/YogurtLid/manifest.json and Mods/YogurtLid/YogurtLid.dll.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI and select food in your toolbar.[/*]
[/list]No extra hotkey or configuration is needed. 

[list=1]
[*]安装 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。[/*]
[*]将 Mod 压缩包解压到游戏的 Mods 目录，确认得到 Mods/YogurtLid/manifest.json 和 Mods/YogurtLid/YogurtLid.dll。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，选中快捷栏中的食物即可。[/*]
[/list]无需额外按键或配置。

[b][size=4]Main features / 主要功能[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Preview added health and energy recovery directly on the vanilla bars, without extra numbers or panels.[/*]
[*]Keep the preview visible and animated during the eating confirmation dialog, using the food being confirmed.[/*]
[*]Update when you switch food or your stats change.[/*]
[*]Use the game's food recovery methods, with handling for several vanilla special cases.[/*]
[*]Local HUD display only: no auto-eating, stat changes, new items, or added save data.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]在原版生命条和体力条上分别预览新增恢复区间，不添加数字提示或独立面板。[/*]
[*]进食确认框期间持续显示和呼吸，以本次待吃的食物为准。[/*]
[*]随食物切换和玩家状态变化更新。[/*]
[*]调用游戏食物恢复方法，并处理部分原版特殊情况。[/*]
[*]仅做本地 HUD 显示，不自动进食，不修改玩家数值，不添加物品或存档数据。[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements / 运行要求[/size][/b]

[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] is required. 

依赖 [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。

[b][size=4]ports / 问题反馈[/size][/b]

请提供游戏、SMAPI、酸奶盖版本，食物名称与品质，其他 HUD/食物 Mod，截图或短视频，以及 [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI 日志链接[/url]。
